The Beauty of Natural Wood, Custom Finished for You

Pianeta Legno Floors is the leading provider of high-quality prefinished engineered hardwood flooring. Since our establishment in the United States in 1998, we have specialized in importing premium engineered floors, ensuring exceptional beauty, durability, and resistance. Our company's foundation in wood flooring, dating back to 1947, shows that our extensive 80 years of expertise guarantee success in every project.

In 2016, we expanded our business by introducing custom finishing of our wood flooring, investing in state-of-the-art machinery from Italy and the U.S. to offer custom finished products that are "Finished in U.S.A". With this success, Pianeta Legno expanded its manufacturing facility in 2023 with brand-new finishing lines designed for all kinds of client profiles.

Offering a wide selection of European-made engineered hardwoods, we provide floors finished with multiple coats of UV-cured polyurethane, water-based finishes, or European-made UV oil finishes. As the oldest and one of the largest importers of engineered wood flooring in the U.S. since 1998, we offer nearly 300 different wood species and finishes to ensure a wide range of options for every project.
